title: Ladder Lab
tagline: A PLC trainer on the classic stoplight program, with a real scan-cycle engine
card_blurb: A PLC trainer on the classic stoplight program: genuine scan-cycle engine, single-scan step mode, a ladder editor with auto-graded challenges, and injectable faults to troubleshoot.
description: **Ladder Lab** — PLC trainer for the classic stoplight program. Genuine input-scan → solve-rungs → output-scan cycle with single-scan step mode and live image tables, AB-style instruction set (XIC/XIO/OTE/OTL/OTU/ONS/TON/TOF/CTU/CTD/RES), animated 4-way intersection wired to the I/O, seven built-in programs, a constrained ladder editor with four auto-graded challenges, and eleven injectable faults for troubleshooting practice. Includes a printable teacher guide.
